note: Set B captures the key facts cleanly — hub height 150 m, 10-m monopile diameter, 120-m blades, 20–30 m clearance range from the footnote, and the Table 4-1 steel/soil values — with only a few chart-range guesses and one invented 'steady-state' condition. Set A repeats many claims and introduces several clear errors: density given as 785E3 kg/m^5 and 785E3 kg/m^3, shear modulus as 793E3 Pa, a 0.18 Hz tower frequency contradicting the stated 0.170 Hz, a 0.0 Hz Kaimal peak, soil shear modulus misbound to the Tower, and 'ground height 30 m' misreading clearance. B does omit the soil Poisson's ratio of 0.4 and its 1P/3P band readings are approximate, but its errors are far fewer.
